section-13-1.FOR: The question whether a person is entitled to carry on an activity which is a reserved legal activity

section-14-1.TO: carry on an activity (“the relevant activity”) which is a reserved legal activity
section-14-1.UNLESS: that person is entitled to carry on the relevant activity

section-14-2.TO: show that the accused did not know, and could not reasonably have been expected to know, that the offence was being committed
section-14-2.IN: proceedings for an offence under subsection (1)

section-15-8.TO: by order make provision about the circumstances in which relevant services do or do not relate to, or have a connection with, the matters mentioned in paragraphs (a) to (d) of subsection (7)

section-15-9.TO: by order make provision about— (a) what does or does not constitute a section of the public; (b) the circumstances in which the provision of relevant services to the public or a section of the public does or does not form part of P's business

section-15-10.TO: make an order under subsection (7), (8) or (9)

section-16-4.TO: show that the accused took all reasonable precautions and exercised all due diligence to avoid committing the offence
section-16-4.IN: proceedings for an offence under subsection (1)

section-17-1.TO: — (a) wilfully pretend to be entitled to carry on any activity which is a reserved legal activity when that person is not so entitled, or (b) with the intention of implying falsely that that person is so entitled, take or use any name, title or description

section-18-2.TO: be authorised to carry on the relevant activity as mentioned in subsection (1)(a)

section-18-5.FOR: a person other than a licensable body
section-18-5.TO: be authorised to carry on the relevant activity as mentioned in subsection (1)(b)

section-20-6.TO: authorise persons to carry on any activity which is a reserved legal activity in respect of which it is a relevant approved regulator

section-23-4.TO: be appointed under subsection (3)(b) for different purposes

section-24-1.TO: by order, amend section 12 or Schedule 2 (reserved legal activities) so as to add any legal activity to the activities which are reserved legal activities for the purposes of this Act

section-24-4.TO: — (a) consider the report containing the recommendation given to the Lord Chancellor under paragraph 16(3)(a) of that Schedule, (b) decide whether or not to make an order under this section in respect of the activity, and (c) publish a notice of that decision
section-24-4.WHERE: a recommendation is made in relation to an activity
section-24-4.WITHIN: the period of 90 days beginning with the day on which the report was given to the Lord Chancellor

section-24-5.TO: state the reasons for that decision
section-24-5.WHERE: the Lord Chancellor decides not to make an order under this section in respect of an activity

section-25-1.TO: by order, make provision— (a) enabling applications to be made, considered and determined under Part 2 of Schedule 4 or Part 1 of Schedule 10 in relation to a provisional reserved activity, as if the activity were a reserved legal activity; (b) enabling provisional designation orders to be made by the Lord Chancellor in respect of a provisional reserved activity, as if the activity were a reserved legal activity

section-25-2.TO: provide that Part 2 of Schedule 4 or Part 1 of Schedule 10 is to apply
section-25-2.IN RELATION TO: such cases as may be specified by the order, with such modifications as may be so specified

section-25-3.TO: by order, make provision— (a) for the purpose of enabling applications for authorisation to carry on an activity which is a provisional reserved activity to be made to and considered and determined by— (i) a body in respect of which a provisional designation order is made, or (ii) the Board in its capacity as a licensing authority; (b) for the purpose of enabling persons to be deemed to be authorised to carry on an activity which is a new reserved legal activity by a relevant approved regulator in connection with the activity, or by the Board in its capacity as a licensing authority, for a period specified in the order

section-26-1.TO: recommend that an activity should cease to be a reserved legal activity

section-26-3.TO: consider any recommendation made by the Board for the purposes of this section

section-26-4.TO: publish a notice to that effect which must include the Lord Chancellor's reasons for disagreeing
section-26-4.WHERE: the Lord Chancellor disagrees with a recommendation (or any part of it)
